newIntro: Students see it in Find a course and ask to join. You approve each request.
createFailed: Couldn't create the course. Try again.
gradeHint: For example 9-A. Shown on the course card.
editIntro: Organise lessons into modules. Students see them in this order; hidden lessons stay invisible to them.
priceHelp: Free courses: students ask to join and the teacher approves. Paid courses: students pay by UPI and you approve the payment on the Payments page.
listedHelp: Students can find it and ask to join. Students already in the course keep access either way.
coverBadType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
coverTooBig: Cover images can be at most {mb} MB.
coverSaved: Cover saved. Students see it in the catalog and on the course page.
uploadFailed: The upload didn't work. Try again.
coverRemoved: Cover removed. The course uses its coloured tile again.
coverHelp: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. A wide image (about 16:9) looks best. Without one, the course shows a tile in its colour.
pricePaid: Saved. Students now pay to join this course.
startHint: Start with a module, for example “Week 1” or “Chapter 1: Number systems”. Then add lessons to it.
looseHelp: Students can't see these. Add them to a module.
noLessons: No lessons in this module yet.
deleteVideoLesson: Deleting the lesson keeps the video; you can add it again from “Videos not in a lesson”.
deleteLesson: This deletes the lesson and its files.
videoHelp: Upload a video file. It becomes a lesson in {module} and appears for students once processed.
title: Title
filesHelp: After you add the lesson, you can attach PDFs, slides and other files.
noRequests: No one is waiting to join.
removed: Removed {name}. They can ask to join again.
noStudents: No students yet. Approve join requests above to add them.
